programmes.d: Den hårde marinesergent John Stryker er meget upopulær blandt mændene i sin deling, især de nye rekrutter, på grund af den brutale træning, han udsætter dem for.
John Wayne adds luster to this early WWII film about the famous P-40 Flying Group who soared into battle against the Japanese in defense of China's freedom, Great dogfight scenes!
After serving with the Union army, John Wayne returns home to be recruited by the governor of Texas to rid the state of crooked carpetbaggers.

Filmen foregår efter anden verdenskrig, og John Wayne spiller Dooley, en tidligere militærpilot, der flyver fragtfly og bliver tvunget til at foretage en nødlanding på en frossen sø, fordi han løber tør for brændstof, og flyet kommer ud af kurs.
A Viennese physician and his daughter, refugees from Hitler, become part of a group of North Dakota townspeople planning to relocate from the dust bowl to greener Oregon.
Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

A young boy sees his parents killed and his brother kidnapped by outlaws, while traveling west on a wagon train. As an adult, he leads a vigilante band seeking the outlaw band, even though his brother is now their scout.

John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

Det femte och sista samarbetet mellan John Wayne och regissör Howard Hawks är en actionfylld westernfilm som utspelar sig efter inbördeskriget. En grupp män är på jakt efter några unionsförrädare som är skyldiga till en serie tågrån.

John Wayne spiller Dan Roman, en veteranpilot, der hjemsøges af en tragisk fortid. Nu degraderet til andenpilot i cockpittet, får han tildelt en rutineflyvning fra Honolulu til San Francisco – en flyvning, der tager en skræmmende vending.
The cattlemen's organization calls upon the Three Mesquiteers to pose as outlaws to round up cattle thieves who cleverly cover their tracks and vanish.

John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.
John Wayne, Constance Towers and William Holden star in this 1863, fact-based story about a Union mission to destroy a railroad junction deep within Confederate territory.
